what: Carbon markets now price 12 billion tonnes a year. The data is a mess.
title: Access Carbon Market Data from Emissions Trading Systems and Voluntary Registries
text: Carbon pricing gone niche instrument systemic part global climate policy. Around 12 billion tonnes CO2-equivalent now covered form carbon price, quarter global emissions. data package returns, EU ETS primary auctions raised EUR 43.2bn across 213 auctions 2025 mean settlement price EUR 73.45, EU ETS covered 1.19 billion tonnes verified emissions 2024, voluntary registries issued 2.65 billion credits since 1996. Article 6 Paris Agreement bringing wave international carbon trading online. catch data scattered across dozens jurisdictions, agencies, registries, format, access pattern, quirks: EU ETS publishes verified emissions allocations via DG CLIMA Union Registry XLSX files year-specific UUIDs, auction prices via EEX per-year XLSX reports UK Emissions Trading Registry publishes compliance allocation reports XLSX, date-stamped filenames change every republication RGGI publishes per-state allowance distributions XLSX stable year-parameterised URL, clearing prices per-auction PDFs California Air Resources Board serves auction prices caps stable CSVs ww2.arb.ca.gov ICAP Allowance Price Explorer exposes cross-ETS prices via undocumented stable JSON endpoint World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard publishes XLSX twice year, filename encodes release date RFF World Carbon Pricing Database published per-country CSVs GitHub May 2026, now serves current data API Berkeley VROD aggregates five voluntary registries bimonthly XLSX release CarbonPlan OffsetsDB publishes parquet snapshots voluntary credits public S3 bucket (REST API deprecated 2026, daily publishing stopped mid-2026) carbondata wraps stable, free, API-accessible sources consistent R interface, handling URL resolution, caching, schema normalisation can get analysis.

title: Access Carbon Market Data from Emissions Trading Systems and Voluntary Registries

code: library(carbondata)  icap <- co2_icap_prices(   jurisdiction = c("EU ETS", "UK ETS", "RGGI", "California") )  plot(icap$date, icap$price, col = factor(icap$jurisdiction),      xlab = "", ylab = "Price per tCO2e (local currency)", pch = 20) legend("topleft", legend = levels(factor(icap$jurisdiction)),        col = seq_len(nlevels(factor(icap$jurisdiction))), pch = 20)

title: Access Carbon Market Data from Emissions Trading Systems and Voluntary Registries
text: Compliance allowances trade far nature-based voluntary credits. two datasets make gap easy quantify. Registry codes VCS (Verra), GOLD, ACR, CAR, ART, ISO. Column names come straight workbook, wrapped headers flattened: sheet stores one column "Total Credits \r\nIssued", carbondata normalises "Total Credits Issued".
code: # EU ETS average auction price, 2024 eu <- co2_euets_price(from = "2024-01-01", to = "2024-12-31") mean(eu$price_eur, na.rm = TRUE)  # Issuances across Verra forestry projects vrod <- co2_vrod() forestry <- vrod[vrod$`Voluntary Registry` == "VCS" &                    vrod$Scope == "Forestry & Land Use", ] summary(forestry$`Total Credits Issued`)

what: A trap worth knowing about: EU ETS2
title: Access Carbon Market Data from Emissions Trading Systems and Voluntary Registries
text: compliance year 2024, DG CLIMA publishes new EU ETS2 (buildings, road transport, small industry) file original ETS1 installations, one aggregate account per member state. 25 accounts added 981 Mt 2024 file, 45% reported total, summing file published roughly doubles country totals. carbondata separates . default ETS1, “EU ETS” always meant:
code: co2_euets_emissions(country = "DE", year = 2024)                   # ETS1 only co2_euets_emissions(country = "DE", year = 2024, scheme = "ets2")  # ETS2 accounts co2_euets_emissions(country = "DE", year = 2024, scheme = "all")   # both, do not sum

title: Access Carbon Market Data from Emissions Trading Systems and Voluntary Registries
text: Carbon market publishers move files without notice, package tracks source health explicitly. August 2026: World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard: host rejects non-browser clients (HTTP 403 regardless user agent). Download file browser pass : co2_world_bank(path = "~/Downloads/data_08_2025.xlsx"). function reports current URL automatic fetch fails. RFF World Carbon Pricing Database: left GitHub 30 May 2026. co2_rff_pricing() reads last openly published release, v2025.0.0. newer vintages request token publisher, use co2_ecp_prices(), stays open updates release. CarbonPlan OffsetsDB: daily publishing became irregular 2026, last snapshot seen 1 June 2026. co2_offsets_db() walks back find newest available warns fortnight old. Climate Action Data Trust: unauthenticated public API. co2_cad_trust() errors guidance self-hosting requesting partnership access. EU ETS installation registry: DG CLIMA’s bulk registry file snapshot dated 28 August 2012. co2_euets_installations() warns every call. current installation detail, use identifiers co2_euets_emissions(). weekly GitHub Actions canary exercises every source opens issue one breaks. Run :
code: Rscript inst/canary/check-endpoints.R

title: Access Carbon Market Data from Emissions Trading Systems and Voluntary Registries
text: Downloads cached tools::R_user_dir("carbondata", "cache") default. Subsequent calls instant. Override location options(carbondata.cache_dir = "/path//dir"). Use co2_clear_cache() remove cached files. Files update place stable name (ICAP price feed, current-year EEX auction report) carry one-day cache limit stale copy served indefinitely. Everything else cached pass refresh = TRUE.
